title: 2.1 Basic Concepts of Climate Change
description: Climate versus weather, global warming, the IPCC definition and the interconnection of Earth systems. Medium level.

questions.question: How does the textbook define climate change?
options: Climate is measured over years; weather over a day
A pattern of change in global climate over many years
A change in climate persisting for decades or longer
Conditions of the atmosphere in a place over many years
questions.correctAnswer: A change in climate persisting for decades or longer

questions.question: What causes does the IPCC definition include for climate change?
options: Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change
Natural variability and human activities
Atmospheric conditions on a particular day
An ecological consequence of global warming

questions.question: How are Earth air, water and land related in climate change?
options: It includes changes in variability and both natural and human causes
They are interdependent, so a change in one place leads to changes elsewhere
A change in the mean or variability of climate persisting for decades or longer
Rising air temperature warms oceans, which then fuel stronger storms
questions.correctAnswer: They are interdependent, so a change in one place leads to changes elsewhere

questions.question: Why do warmer oceans lead to stronger storms?
options: A trend persists across many years while variability is short-term
Oceans absorb more heat from the atmosphere and fuel storms
Climate change requires a persistent pattern over many years
Short fluctuations do not represent a change in climate state
questions.correctAnswer: Oceans absorb more heat from the atmosphere and fuel storms

questions.question: Which phrase distinguishes climate from weather?
options: Climate is measured over years; weather over a day
They trap heat and raise air temperatures near the ground
A long-term increase in Earth average temperature
Conditions of the atmosphere in a place over many years
questions.correctAnswer: Climate is measured over years; weather over a day

questions.question: What is meant by global climate change?
options: Conditions of the atmosphere in a place over many years
A pattern of change in global climate over many years
Short fluctuations do not represent a change in climate state
Climate change requires a persistent pattern over many years
questions.correctAnswer: A pattern of change in global climate over many years

questions.question: Which observed trend do scientists study as an important indicator?
options: Earth average temperature
A description of climate
Gondar is cold in winter
Typically decades or longer

questions.question: What happens when air temperatures rise?
options: Atmospheric conditions on a particular day
A long-term increase in Earth average temperature
Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change
Oceans absorb more heat and become warmer
questions.correctAnswer: Oceans absorb more heat and become warmer

questions.question: Which example is used in the textbook to describe a regional climate?
options: The Horn of Africa
A description of climate
Earth average temperature
Gondar is cold in winter

questions.question: Which statement about climate change consequences is accurate?
options: It includes changes in variability and both natural and human causes
A trend persists across many years while variability is short-term
Rising air temperature warms oceans, which then fuel stronger storms
They extend beyond rising temperatures to ecosystems and storms
questions.correctAnswer: They extend beyond rising temperatures to ecosystems and storms
